purpose: Give Constitutional Capitalism a single coherent core economic engine: public income without ordinary labor/home taxes; credit that builds local assets; worker→owner pathways; rules against extractive concentration.

master_architecture_fragment.title: Money & Ownership Engine
master_architecture_fragment.one_sentence: Arkansas turns production and external demand into household prosperity and public income by broadening ownership, directing credit to productive local assets, pricing extraction/use rather than ordinary wages and homes, and blocking monopoly/PE pathways that reconcentrate wealth and political power.

flow.label: Ownership structure + competition rules determine who captures surplus (LOCK-04, LOCK-05)
Banking/credit/public capital convert surplus into future local assets (LOCK-02)
Public income engines claim reserved cash from use/impact/depletion/visitor/enterprise/external income (LOCK-01)
State + Community Prosperity Ledgers fund services; Residual Wealth only as last shock absorber
Anti-concentration + anti-capture rules keep economic winners from rewriting the rules (joins LOCK-09 later)

module_homes.function: Fund government without ordinary IIT/property tax
module_homes.funded_how: Ten engines + reserved Tax Retirement / Prosperity Fund; COUNTABLE only when free cash clears
module_homes.household_effect: Ordinary wages and homes leave compulsory base as engines earn replacement
module_homes.capture_prevention: Diversified engines; residual wealth on surplus beneficial ownership; no abolish-today

module_homes.function: Create and allocate credit; form capital
module_homes.funded_how: Deposits, public/community capital vehicles, pension/local reinvestment rules (design-level)
module_homes.household_effect: Access to productive credit; less interest leakage
module_homes.capture_prevention: Separate payment utility from speculative leverage; geographic return disclosure

module_homes.funded_how: Enterprise returns, public IP share ∝ public contribution, procurement (Pass 3)
module_homes.capture_prevention: Broad ownership disperses workplace and political power

module_homes.funded_how: Competition policy, public options/yardsticks, disclosure covenants — not a new tax by default

os_crosscut_pass_result.ownership: Spine centers who owns firms, credit claims, land-adjacent enterprise surplus, and public claim on engines
os_crosscut_pass_result.capital_formation: LOCK-02 is the conversion gear; Prosperity Fund is the public accumulation tank
os_crosscut_pass_result.market_design: LOCK-05 sets anti-extraction rules; LOCK-04 sets ownership incentives
os_crosscut_pass_result.household_economics: Spine succeeds only if households gain income/assets/time — not if GDP rises alone
os_crosscut_pass_result.power: Without LOCK-05 (+ later LOCK-09), LOCK-01 engines can be captured; firewall is structural
